plainTranslation: Their Pluto in your 4th house: they reach your roots - family wounds, your deepest security, what home means. Transformative, sometimes destabilizing. Failure mode: control over your private life, or old wounds reopened and used against you. Let the depth heal; name it if it turns controlling.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
